first_notice: Water damage to kitchen floor and lower cabinets.
adjuster_notes: 2024-07-15 Spoke to insured. Braided supply hose to the dishwasher split while they were at dinner, water ran for about two hours before they got home.
2024-07-16 Site visit. Hose failure confirmed, insured shut off the valve under the sink on discovery. Insured has kept the failed hose in a bag for inspection.
2024-07-18 Contractor estimate for flooring and two base cabinets received: 8,400.

first_notice: Water damage in upstairs bathroom and ceiling below.
adjuster_notes: 2024-08-03 Insured noticed a stain on the dining room ceiling and a soft spot in the bathroom floor above.
2024-08-06 Plumber opened the floor. Pinhole leak on the copper line to the toilet. Subfloor is rotted and there is mould growth on the joists.
2024-08-06 Plumber's written opinion: the staining pattern and rot show the line had been leaking for roughly six to eight weeks.
2024-08-09 Estimate for subfloor, joist treatment and dining room ceiling: 11,750.

first_notice: Basement took on water during the storm.
adjuster_notes: 2024-09-20 Insured reports two feet of water in the finished basement after the storm.

2024-09-21 Site visit. Floor drain and sump are both working. The creek behind the property overtopped its banks; water line on the exterior wall matches the interior, and water came in through the basement window wells.
2024-09-23 Estimate for drywall, flooring and furnace: 23,900.

first_notice: Water in the basement.
adjuster_notes: 2024-06-12 Heavy rain overnight. Insured found dark water around the basement floor drain in the morning.
2024-06-13 Site visit. Water came up through the floor drain. City confirms the municipal sewer main surcharged on the street that night. No surface water entry, window wells dry.
2024-06-14 Cleanup and restoration estimate: 14,200.

first_notice: Sump pump failed and the basement flooded.
adjuster_notes: 2024-12-23 Insured says the sump pump stopped and the pit overflowed into the basement.
2024-12-24 Utility outage report confirms power to the street was out from 02:00 on 12-22 to 18:30 the same day during the ice storm.
2024-12-24 Battery backup unit was replaced in April 2024, receipt provided. The battery ran down during the outage. Pump itself tested fine once power returned.

first_notice: Burst pipe at rental property.
adjuster_notes: 2024-10-09 Landlord reports a burst supply line under the kitchen sink at the rental. Found when showing the unit to a prospective tenant.
2024-10-10 Last tenant moved out on 2024-08-24, so the unit had been empty 45 days at the date of loss.
2024-10-10 Landlord states he shut off the water at the main and drained the lines the week the tenant left.
2024-10-11 Landlord's first visit to the unit after the tenancy ended was on 2024-09-13. He has no record of any earlier inspection of the plumbing.

first_notice: Hail damage to roof.
adjuster_notes: 2024-05-06 Roof is standing-seam metal. Numerous hail dents across the south and west panels.
2024-05-08 Inspection: no punctures, no leaks in the attic, panels still shed water normally. Damage is denting only.
2024-05-09 Roofer quote to replace the panels: 19,800.

first_notice: Water damage in the kitchen.
Burglary, laptops and camera equipment stolen from the house.
adjuster_notes: 2024-08-28 Police report filed. Two laptops and a camera kit taken from the home office.
2024-08-29 Insured runs a wedding photography business from the house. Tax return shows gross receipts of 38,000 for the last 12 months.
2024-08-29 All stolen items are used for the photography business. Replacement cost 6,000, receipts provided. Items were at the house when stolen.

first_notice: Leak under the bathroom sink.
adjuster_notes: 2024-11-06 Insured found water under the vanity and a warped cabinet base. Not sure when the leak started, they rarely use that bathroom.
2024-11-07 Plumber replaced a failed compression fitting on the supply line. The old fitting was thrown away by the plumber.

first_notice: Water in the family room after a storm.
adjuster_notes: 2024-08-12 Spoke to insured Mrs. Joan Pell at 14 Larch Road. A thunderstorm on 11 August; the weather station recorded 62 mm of rain in 24 hours. Water pooled on the patio and ran in under the patio door into the family room.
2024-08-14 Carpets and skirting boards soaked. Estimate 4,800.

first_notice: Rain came in through the front door.
adjuster_notes: 2024-12-31 Storm overnight, 71 mm of rain in 24 hours at the nearest station. Insured Mr. Felix Grant says water came in under the front door and across the hall and lounge floors.
2025-01-02 Laminate lifted throughout. Estimate 6,200.

first_notice: Storm water under the back door.
adjuster_notes: 2025-01-01 New Year's Day storm; the weather station recorded 58 mm of rain in 24 hours. Insured Ms. Hannah Kerr found water coming in under the back door into the kitchen.
2025-01-03 Kitchen units and flooring damaged. Estimate 7,900.

first_notice: Water through a basement window in heavy rain.
adjuster_notes: 2025-03-14 Heavy rain, 66 mm in 24 hours. Water came in through the basement window frame.
2025-03-15 Insured Mr. Daniel Reyes, 9 Kestrel Way, phone (555) 410-2210. Plaster and flooring damaged. Estimate 3,900.

first_notice: River flooded the ground floor.
adjuster_notes: 2025-02-10 After snowmelt the river burst its banks; 40 cm of river water across the ground floor.
2025-02-12 No rainfall event recorded locally. Estimate 22,000.

first_notice: Burst pipe in the utility room.
adjuster_notes: 2024-10-12 Supply line to the washing machine split; found within the hour and shut off.
2024-10-13 Insured says the policy is active. Estimate 5,100.

first_notice: Ceiling came down after a leak upstairs.
adjuster_notes: 2024-10-28 Toilet supply hose burst in the upstairs bathroom; the ceiling below collapsed.
2024-10-29 Insured bought the policy last week. Estimate 8,700.

first_notice: Frozen pipe burst in the loft.
adjuster_notes: 2025-01-03 Pipe in the loft froze and split; found the same morning.
2025-01-04 Renewal was paid on 5 January. Estimate 4,300.

first_notice: Sewer backup in the basement.
adjuster_notes: 2024-07-21 Municipal sewer surcharged in a storm and backed up through the floor drain into the finished basement.
2024-07-23 Insured Mr. Omar Haddad's son cut his hand on broken glass while moving boxes and needed 4 stitches. Estimate for the basement 12,600.

first_notice: Work laptop and camera stolen from a car.
adjuster_notes: 2024-09-05 Insured runs a graphic design business from home; gross receipts were 41,000 over the last 12 months. Laptop and camera used for the business were stolen from the car outside a client's office.
2024-09-06 Police report filed. Value 3,600.

first_notice: Fire; the rebuild must meet current code.
adjuster_notes: 2024-06-30 Kitchen fire. The city requires the rebuild, including the undamaged rooms, to meet current building code; increased cost of construction quoted at 40,000.
2024-07-02 Insured Dr. Samuel Achebe was treated in hospital for smoke inhalation and released.

first_notice: Burst supply line at a rented condo.
adjuster_notes: 2024-11-30 The loss is at a condo the insured owns in another city and rents out, not at the insured's own home. It stood empty 45 days between tenants and the water was left on when a supply line burst.

first_notice: Hail dented the metal roof.
adjuster_notes: 2024-09-03 Hail dented the metal roof panels; the roofer finds no leaks and the panels still shed water.
2024-09-05 Insured wants the whole roof replaced. Estimate 16,800.

first_notice: Burst pipe behind the dishwasher.
adjuster_notes: 2024-02-10 Dishwasher supply hose split; found within two hours and the water shut off.

first_notice: Burst fitting at an empty rental.
adjuster_notes: 2024-09-03 Tenant left on 1 September. Landlord, who lives abroad, had a plumber shut the water off at the main and drain the system on 3 September.
2024-10-20 No inspection of the unit was done after the tenant left. Neighbour reported water under the door: a supply line fitting burst. Estimate 11,200.
